Resolves #19917

RealWorld v1 renders with its Conduit theme again. Its home view shows one *Popular Tags* sidebar with every tag, and its article page renders: body, tags, one comment form, each comment once, and the article's date in both meta blocks. All changes are in `apps/realworld`, plus one e2e spec and its `RUN_PATHS` entry.

Evidence: L3 (browser e2e with the RealWorld API and showdown served from fixtures, plus a local run against the live jsDelivr theme and avatar) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI, `RealWorldV1.spec.mjs`: one sidebar, one pill per tag and no duplicate ids. Checked in the plain load order, and in the held order where the tags land right behind the articles |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, live: the pinned jsDelivr stylesheet answers 200 `text/css; charset=utf-8`, and the header, feed toggle and tag pills render in the Conduit theme |
| AC-3 | CI: one comment form above the comment, and the comment shown once. Outside CI, live: the default avatar answers 200 `image/svg+xml` and renders at 150px |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: loading the home and article views wrote no `console.log` (local run, 3/3) |

## Deltas from ticket

- **#19922's app trigger.** Views were created with only a `parentId` and got their `windowId` when the container inserted them, after `onConstructed()` had created the tag list. The tag list kept `windowId: null`, and its update during the home view's flight was dropped. Views now take the container's `appName` and `windowId` at creation, and so does every child they create. The engine side stays in #19922.
- **Two article-view defects, found while proving AC-3; `dev` fails the same way.**
  - `afterSetTagList()` wrote to `cn[1]` of the body node's empty children while the body's html was still on its way from the main thread. The hole at `cn[0]` made the next update throw in `TreeBuilder`, so the article view never rendered. The slot now starts as a `removeDom` placeholder.
  - Comments were embedded by their own vdom and rendered twice. They are now embedded by reference, like the tag list and the comment form.
- The article actions showed the template's placeholder date, "January 20th"; both meta blocks now show the article's date.

## Test Evidence

- `RealWorldV1.spec.mjs` ×15 at head: 45/45 green.
- On `dev`'s `apps/realworld`, the held-order and article tests fail 3/3: two sidebars with duplicate ids, and the `TreeBuilder` error.
- With the theme and reference fix but without the `windowId` one, the held-order test fails 5/5 with an empty sidebar.
- The plain-order home test is not a reliable red on `dev`: with instant fixtures the tags often arrive before the home view renders. The held-order test is the deterministic one.
- The new date assertion fails against the previous article view.
- Live, against the real jsDelivr theme and avatar (local run, 3/3, the fixture's worker-error guard included): stylesheet 200 `text/css`, avatar 200 at 150px, one comment form, no app console output, no worker error.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] After the 13.3 deploy, https://neomjs.com/dist/production/apps/realworld/index.html renders styled, with one *Popular Tags* sidebar, and an article opens.

## Commits

- `be26f39c25`: theme from jsDelivr, tag list and comment form by reference, the avatar, debug logs removed
- `fd10df0394`: views and their children are born with `appName` and `windowId`; the e2e spec
- `6e7738cb50`: the article view's body slot, comments by reference
- `33327fe0a3`: the article actions' date
